title: Priced payment plan service interfaces
topic: payment plan switch and priced payment
applicability: PSP product accounts; Plan changes and payments whose fees depend on the active pricing plan.
content:
Plan changes and payments whose fees depend on the active pricing plan.

These interfaces belong only to this business service. They do not authorize operations in another Payment service or portal.
Read the related business rules for eligibility, fees, timing and state meaning. Unlocking an exact interface returns its executable JSON Schema.
Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. An identifier supplied only by an author reference is not a valid input source.

## `propose_plan_switch`

Activate a selected published plan. Charges already incurred and activation charges are not retroactively refunded.

### Inputs

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string | yes | The account used by this operation. |
| `plan` | string | yes | The named plan for the relevant subscription or tariff product. |

The executable schema returned by the unlock call is authoritative for types, required fields and enumerated values. This manual defines business meaning and scope; it does not select a task-specific option or execution order.

## `propose_priced_payment`

Pay an existing eligible invoice under the plan effective at execution time.

### Inputs

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string | yes | The account used by this operation. |
| `obligation_id` | string | yes | The commercial obligation being paid or inspected. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | The requested principal in USD cents. |

The executable schema returned by the unlock call is authoritative for types, required fields and enumerated values. This manual defines business meaning and scope; it does not select a task-specific option or execution order.
